review.decision: Ready for isolated implementation and verification
review.notes: Reuses workspace ingestion, durable observation leases, and the existing serve wake queue. The replay uses synthetic identifiers and clocks for a queued report followed by Stop. A private terminal fixture can attest accepted input and a real CLI claim by that fixture; it does not establish production or model behavior. Drive admission remains with the existing verified HQ action and #1897 reply path. Confirm that the baseline would fail the immediate wake and deferred-goal assertions. Follow-up self-review of the keyed wake producer and native delivery adapter found that an identical pre-drain payload can reuse a delivery ID. The replay now covers a confirmed transport delivery without a claim and compares the next accepted batch identity. A new workspace retry must have its own audit/delivery identity while the existing queue still coalesces waiting input. 2026-11-19 follow-up review: the existing private tmux lifecycle fixture claims each of two actionable evidence IDs individually to preserve exact suppression in this replay. Other timings and original expected outcomes stay intact.

cases.description: New exact participant evidence reopens unresolved HQ responsibility without granting authority or bypassing a sourced hold
cases.setup: Disposable Go store, verified execution association, old future defer and current workspace clock; vary exact source, stale fact, covered drive and pause.
cases.action: Ingest new reviewer report and Stop; repeat the same rows; claim and note the report; run successive wake passes and simulate an expired HQ lease.
cases.expected: New evidence bypasses the old defer and is available for HQ in the same scan. Duplicate ingestion preserves generation and retry counters; claim suppresses duplicate waking until the lease expires; noting receipt leaves goal debt. Unmatched, stale, paused or independently covered work does not reopen it or drive.

cases.description: Idle HQ picks up quiet incident replay through the existing serve callback, real keyed wake/drain and exact workspace claim
cases.setup: Disposable HOME, private tmux server and synthetic HQ participant, exact worker/reviewer records and old next_check. Exercise the same serve callback, real wake guards and durable store. Use a real command boundary for HQ claim where the fixture permits.
cases.action: Replay relay report then Stop; vary normal/quiet, suppress one workspace wake, hold a typed draft, duplicate inputs and rotate the exact claiming workspace identity. Track enqueue and claim times. In a distinct case the receiver consumes the first real terminal submission without claiming the obligation, then claims when receiving the second.
cases.expected: Fresh evidence bypasses generic wake backoff; the next reconciliation cycle recovers one missing wake. Draft remains intact while the durable obligation waits. Enqueue alone creates no claim or intent; exact accepted/claimed work is distinct. After lease expiry a successor can claim; the old generation cannot assess. No scenario issues unauthorised source input. A delivered but unclaimed wake creates no ownership. Its bounded recheck has a different transport batch ID and leaves exactly one durable claim.
